messages.text:
Hi,

I placed an order Sunday for a Hammer Thor P2 for $369. Shortly afterward,
I received your Thanksgiving promotion email advertising three Hammer BC04
miners for $478.

I’m interested in switching my order to that bundle, but I can’t find it on
your website.

Is the bundle still available? If so, would it be possible to switch my
existing order and pay the difference before it ships?
Thanks
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 bundle 3 pack
Searched the catalog · Thanksgiving bundle three BC04 miners trio

Hi,

Thanks for writing in, and good news on the principle: an order that has not shipped yet can be switched to another product, and any difference is invoiced to you before it goes out. So what you are asking for is normally straightforward.

The part I cannot confirm is the bundle itself. Our Thanksgiving bundles are real, but the three Hammer BC04 pack is not published on the site at the moment, which is why you could not find it, and the version I can see is not priced at $478. I do not want to quote you a figure that turns out to be wrong, so I have put it in front of a colleague to confirm the promotional price and whether we can hold it for your order.

The team is offline for the evening and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes straight back to you by email, so you do not need to do anything in the meantime.

One thing that will speed it up: please reply with your order number, so we switch the right order and nothing moves before you have agreed the price.

Best regards,
Sarah H.

Thanks for the quick response. Here is my order and here is the promotional
email I got for the 3 hammer bc04s for $478. Thank you.

Hi Jack,

Thanks for sending both, that clears it up. I have your order Shop···· in front of me: one Hammer Miner Thor P2 at $369 plus $18.40 shipping, paid, nothing picked or packed yet, and the Thor P2 line is currently showing a ship date of November 3.

On the bundle, you read the email right. The Bitcoin Trio, two BC04 with the third free at $478, is in our Thanksgiving mailing. What I can see on our side is that the pack is not published on the store yet and the version sitting there is priced differently, so I am not able to set it to $478 myself or sell it to you tonight. That is a pricing call, and I would rather it come back to you correct than guess.

So here is where it stands. Your order is flagged and nothing on it will be shipped or changed while this is open, and a colleague picks it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, well before the 2pm cut-off in the email. They will confirm the $478 price, and if it is confirmed I switch your order straight over, with the difference invoiced to you before anything leaves the warehouse. You will get that answer by email in this same thread.

Best regards,
Sarah H.

Hi Jack,

You are welcome. Nothing more is needed from you tonight, your order stays as it is and the team comes back to you in this thread tomorrow morning with the answer on the $478 Bitcoin Trio.

Talk soon,
Sarah
HeliumDeploy

Hello. No one reached out to me and I see that my original order shipped.
Did you find anything out about the trio deal?

Hi Jack,

You are right on both counts, and I am sorry. Nobody came back to you, and your Thor P2 left our Chattanooga warehouse yesterday, after I told you it would stay put. That should not have happened and it was our mistake, not yours.

Where it stands now. The T. P2 is in transit to (address hidden) with tracking ····, currently showing arrival around October 22. Because it has shipped, I can no longer switch that order over to the trio from my side.

On the Bitcoin Trio at $478, the pack is still not published on the store and the version on our side is priced higher, so I am not able to sell it to you at the emailed price myself. I have put the whole thing back in front of a colleague with your order, the promotional email and what went wrong here, and they are in the office now, so you will get a reply from them today in this thread on whether we do the trio at $478 for you and how we handle the Thor P2 that is already on its way.

In the meantime I have made you a code for the mishandling, HD-••••••, $25 off a future order over $100. It is yours alone.

Sorry again for the silence this week.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy
Okay sounds good. Thank you for the update Sarah!

Hi Jack,

Thanks for being patient with us on this one. Nothing else is needed from you, my colleague has everything and comes back to you here today on the $478 trio and on the Thor P2 that is on its way.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy
